- **35OFF** – Promo code **35OFF** has been recently verified as working successfully by multiple users. This is currently the best active promo code, providing **35% off select items** — significantly better than the 90-day average discount of 27%.

### 💰 Current Deals & Offers
- **50% off your first 3 app orders** — download the app and order through mobile. New app users only.

### 📱 App & Rewards Tips
- Download the Domino's app to unlock exclusive coupon codes and offers — it also has built-in order tracking.
- Sign up for the **Domino's Rewards** program to earn points on all orders. For every order of $5 or more, you earn 10 points, and once you've collected 60 points, you get a free pizza.
- **Follow Domino's on social media** — it's one of the easiest ways to catch promo codes, flash deals, and free food offers. They regularly check Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok for deals.

---

### 🚗 Save More with Carryout
- Carryout is cheaper than delivery at Domino's. For example, a large hand-tossed pizza and 8-piece Garlic Parmesan Wings came to $15.98 with the Mix & Match carryout deal, vs. $26.48 for delivery plus a $4.99 fee — that's over $15 in savings.

- Visit Domino's website or download the app and click **"Coupons"** to find current promotions — you can browse both national coupons and deals available at your local store.
- Check voucher sites like **SimplyCodes**, **CouponFollow**, **Savings.com**, and **CouponCabin** for regularly updated codes.
